author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_body_tv_frame.rs::{spec_helper_req_straight_line_body_is_not_divergent, spec_helper_req_v1_while_loop_is_not_divergent} demonstrate the divergence (audit of #162, commit 540cea0d). Root cause: body_tv::corpus_req threads the source req VERBATIM into BodyObligationFrame/LoopObligationFrame with spec_defs: Vec::new(), so a req referencing a spec fn helper (the 'req sorted(haystack)' design idiom) makes the obligation an undefined-fn compile error; run_obligation maps the no-results non-success exit to CompileAbort -> BodyVerdict::Divergent ('a real body-lowering infidelity') + exit 1, although the production lowering is exactly faithful. The sibling exec_tv::check_corpus_expr gates the req on every referenced ident being env-declared, explicitly because otherwise it is 'a FRAMING failure, not an infidelity'. Worst on the loop arm: the ENTRY obligation (loop-tv.md REQ-2, proof fn with NO production text) compile-aborts on the frame and is reported 'the production loop text did not compile'. Authority: exec-stmt-tv.md REQ-5 (Divergent <=> lowering and reference DISAGREE; non-derivable frame = Skipped class), loop-tv.md four-way (Divergent = production-side counterexample). RELATED (same overclaiming family, not separately test-pinned: not deterministically reachable at the pinned rlimit 30 from the v1 .th surface): a genuine Z3 rlimit exhaustion emits 'Resource limit (rlimit) exceeded' WITH a results line counting it as an error (probed live), so Errors>=1 -> Divergent, while loop-tv.md pins 'Unverifiable - a Verus/Z3 timeout'. forge check distinguishes this via --profile (classify_verus_outcome Timeout); run_obligation passes no --profile. The fix should address both: gate/thread the frame like exec_tv (or thread spec_defs), and keep a timeout out of the Divergent class.
